item.title: Why I Have A Static Website
item.description: The World Wide Web was built as a way to manage information. An elegant design containing URLs, HTTP and HTML. That was all you needed to open any page on the internet, using a device that can access it. Much like our minds, we can hop between topics connected by links and browse down rabbit holes as much as we can. It’s simple enough for many people to build their own page and express themselves without bureaucracy.

item.title: Starstruck
item.description:
What a Day

April 8 2024 is ingrained, burnt into my eyes. Witnessing a solar eclipse is easily one of the best experiences I have had

2 years on, I was looking back at my photos and came across this oldie but goodie.

Every time I look at it, it makes me smile.

item.title: About
item.description:
hi, i am suchitra.

among many things, i am an amateur astronomer and i believe everyone must experience the wonder of looking at a sky with stars. i actively host and participate in star parties wherever i live as a way to build community.

presently, i work in the biopharmaceutical industry building software that allow scientists to capture and reuse data. previously, i was that said scientist. i loved biochemistry but got frustrated with systems that made it easier to repeat an entire experiment than searching and finding data that already existed.
